plan_limits.name: plan_limits
plan_limits.value: ("plans"."builtin" and "plans"."rate_limit" is null and "plans"."rate_limit_unit" is null and "plans"."monthly_quota" is null) or (not "plans"."builtin" and "plans"."rate_limit" is not null and "plans"."rate_limit_unit" is not null and "plans"."monthly_quota" is not null and "plans"."rate_limit" > 0 and "plans"."rate_limit_unit" in ('second','minute') and "plans"."monthly_quota" >= "plans"."rate_limit")

tracing_selection_target.name: tracing_selection_target
tracing_selection_target.value: ("tracing_selections"."kind" = 'api' and "tracing_selections"."api_id" is not null and "tracing_selections"."user_id" is null and "tracing_selections"."team_id" is null) or ("tracing_selections"."kind" = 'developer' and "tracing_selections"."api_id" is null and "tracing_selections"."user_id" is not null and "tracing_selections"."team_id" is null) or ("tracing_selections"."kind" = 'team' and "tracing_selections"."api_id" is null and "tracing_selections"."user_id" is null and "tracing_selections"."team_id" is not null)
